payload.title: The two gateway-api WebSocket NATS bridges read NATS_AUTH_TOKEN, NATS_AUTH_USER and NATS_AUTH_PASS themselves and write them onto the connection options after buildNatsConnectionOptions, so a cert-identity (mtls-cert) connection can carry CONNECT-frame credentials that ADR-015 forbids
evidence: apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/nats-bridge.service.ts:111-121 (reads NATS_AUTH_TOKEN, NATS_AUTH_USER, NATS_AUTH_PASS and writes token, or user and pass, onto connectionOptions whatever authMode the factory chose)
apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/st-language-bridge.service.ts:113-123 (the same block in the second bridge)
libs/backend-common/src/nats/nats-connection.factory.ts:277-291 (the factory sets token or user and pass only for authMode token or user-pass and leaves them unset for mtls-cert, by design)
apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/nats-bridge.service.ts:96-107 (the bridge also rebuilds connectionOptions.tls from raw NATS_TLS_* env, replacing the factory's validated tls object)
apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/st-language-bridge.service.ts:99-111 (the same TLS rebuild in the second bridge)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md NATS Authentication (ADR-014 / ADR-015): identity comes only from the mTLS client cert CN and user/pass in the CONNECT frame is forbidden; the factory is the one builder of NATS connection options (SEC-H01)
payload.notes: In production the gateway runs in mtls-cert mode: the factory deliberately returns no user, pass or token, but both bridges then read the three env vars and set them if present. Any environment that defines NATS_AUTH_USER and NATS_AUTH_PASS (or NATS_AUTH_TOKEN) for gateway-api, for example a shared dev or CI env file, puts credentials in the CONNECT frame next to the certificate, which ADR-015 forbids and which makes it unclear which field authenticated. The production compose file does not set them today (docker-compose.prod.yml gateway-api block lists only the NATS_TLS_* variables), so the defect is latent there; nothing in a test or gate fails when it becomes live, and the DET crossfile-2 READ rule reports both bridges as true positives on clean main. Close condition: Both bridges build their ConnectionOptions only from buildNatsConnectionOptions (no read of NATS_AUTH_* or NATS_TLS_* under apps/gateway-api/src/websocket), the DET crossfile-2 baseline pin that lists these two bridge findings (security-boundary-adapter.nats.test.ts, open PR #2134) becomes [], and a test or invariant fails when any non-test module outside the factory reads NATS_AUTH_USER, NATS_AUTH_PASS or NATS_AUTH_TOKEN. Verified at origin/main d716541239.
